low.title: Half-Day Szentendre Art Route (Low Budget)
low.summary: A simple and affordable art-filled walk through Szentendre’s creative streets, small galleries, and Hungarian snacks.

schedule.title: Old Town Art Corners
schedule.description: Start with a walk through narrow streets filled with colorful façades and small public art pieces.

schedule.title: Free/Low-Cost Gallery Visit
schedule.description: Visit one of the smaller galleries with symbolic or low entry fees.

schedule.title: Budget Local Snack
schedule.description: Try lángos or a simple warm Hungarian dish from an affordable spot.

schedule.title: Artisan Street + Craft Shops
schedule.description: Browse handmade ceramics and artworks without needing to buy anything.

schedule.title: Riverside Finish
schedule.description: End by the Danube, sketching, taking photos, or simply relaxing.

medium.title: Balanced Half-Day Art Experience
medium.summary: A comfortable and relaxed art-focused half-day including galleries, local food, and Szentendre’s iconic creative streets.

schedule.title: Historic Art Walk
schedule.description: Walk through Szentendre’s charming old center filled with art shops and creative corners.

schedule.title: Art Mill Museum Visit
schedule.description: Explore a mid-range art museum showcasing exhibitions of local and regional artists.

schedule.title: Mid-Range Local Lunch or Snack
schedule.description: Enjoy a warm Hungarian meal in a cozy restaurant.

schedule.title: Riverside Photography Spot
schedule.description: Finish with a calm river walk and photo-friendly views.

high.title: High-End Half-Day Art Route
high.summary: A refined half-day art experience featuring premium galleries and a high-quality meal.

schedule.title: Premium Art Street Walk
schedule.description: Visit elegant art boutiques and craft studios.

schedule.title: Curated Gallery Visit
schedule.description: Explore high-level exhibition spaces with curated works.

schedule.title: High-End Local Lunch
schedule.description: Enjoy premium Hungarian dishes with beautiful presentation.

schedule.title: Scenic River Lookout
schedule.description: End your half day with the best riverside views.

comfortable.title: Luxury Half-Day Art Experience
comfortable.summary: The most elegant art-focused half-day route with fine dining, curated galleries, and scenic viewpoints.

schedule.title: Exclusive Old Town Art Walk
schedule.description: Start with a curated walk through Szentendre’s most beautiful art-filled areas.

schedule.title: VIP Gallery Visit
schedule.description: High-end exhibition rooms featuring premium Hungarian and international artworks.

schedule.title: Fine Dining Local Lunch
schedule.description: A luxury meal inspired by Hungarian culinary tradition.

schedule.title: Riverside Panorama Finish
schedule.description: Relax at a premium scenic spot by the Danube.
